LESSON: GASEOUS EXCHANGE AND RESPIRATION

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: BIOLOGY
Strand: Anatomy and Physiology of Plants
Topic 2.3: Gaseous Exchange and Respiration
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 22

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Gaseous Exchange and Respiration, part of Anatomy and Physiology of Plants in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 BIOLOGY.

Key inquiry question: Why is gaseous exchange important to plants? 2. How is respiration useful to plants?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Gaseous Exchange and Respiration together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: The learner cooperates with others while discussing theories explaining the

mechanism of opening and closing of stomata.

• Learning to Learn: The learner applies the information acquired on the economic importance of anaerobic

respiration to carry out the project.

Values:
• Responsibility: The learner appropriately disposes off the products of fermentation.

• Social justice: The learner ensures equity, equality and gender balance in distribution of learning resources during

group activities.

adjustable tables, organic substrates, adapted digital devices, print and non-print media, delivery tube, yeast, test tubes,
